prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return CommonJS module solution.js.
Required API: exports.parseNetstring = function(text), returning a string or null
Behavior: Parse exactly one ASCII netstring length:payload,. The length is decimal bytes with no sign and no leading zero except the single digit 0; payload must be printable ASCII, its byte length must match, and no trailing data is allowed.
Visible example: "5:hello," produces "hello", while "05:hello," fails.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: exports.parseNetstring=function(s){const m=/^(0|[1-9][0-9]*):/.exec(s);if(!m)return null;const n=Number(m[1]),a=m[0].length;if(!Number.isSafeInteger(n)||a+n+1!==s.length||s[a+n]!==',')return null;const p=s.slice(a,a+n);for(const c of p)if(c.charCodeAt(0)<32||c.charCodeAt(0)>126)return null;return p}
